cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Who Cares More?
cards.instruction: Turn every favor, memory, sacrifice, and affectionate gesture into evidence that you care more.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've folded the corners of all our tickets like yours. Twelve memories carefully marked. How many did you keep?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That corner caught in my zip. I made you an album instead.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes, protect the corners. I've kept your album wrapped in tissue all this time. You made it; I've looked after it.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Open it. All my tickets are inside.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'm protecting both collections. I'll get a waterproof cover; you just enjoy remembering.

reason: Replace the abstract your-caring-needs-me explanation with concrete preservation and a pointed comparison; make the correction cover an instruction.
